title: RGPD
intro: Manage which archers opted out of public visibility (RGPD), print anonymized documents, and publish results to ianseo.net with opted-out archers automatically replaced by an anonymous placeholder.

participants.intro: Check "RGPD private" for an archer to opt them out of public results publication and anonymized prints. Saved immediately, one archer at a time.
participants.empty: No participant found for this tournament.

prints.intro: Anonymized equivalents of Ianseo's own printable documents -- archers marked "RGPD private" on the Participants list tab are shown as "Archer #<id>" instead of their real name. Opens in a new window, same as Ianseo's native prints.

status.optedOutNone: No archer in this tournament has opted out of public results publication.
status.optedOutSome: {count} archer(s) in this tournament opted out of public results publication -- they will be replaced by an anonymous placeholder in what gets published.
status.testMode: No ianseo.net credentials configured for this tournament yet -- test mode: preview works, but Publish is disabled until credentials are set on Ianseo's own "Send to Ianseo.net" screen (Tournament > Send to Ianseo.net > Set credentials).
status.credentialsConfigured: ianseo.net credentials found for this tournament.

events.empty: No event found for this tournament.

preview.title: Preview
preview.hint: This is what would be sent -- nothing has been sent to ianseo.net yet.

result.success: Published to ianseo.net. {count} archer(s) were anonymized.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.noSelection: Select at least one item to publish.
